sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 63454"
sources.quote: HD 63454, formally named Ceibo, is a star located in the southern circumpolar constellation Chamaeleon near the border with Mensa.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 0.8 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,731 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

sources.quote: To see the star, one needs a small telescope because it has an apparent magnitude of 9.36, which is below the limit for naked eye visibility.
